gaps.explanation: Nothing missing. The JSON debt_proceeds 59,975 is the printed Bond proceeds (p4, Total column), and detail has it once: Budget and Actual - General Fund (p5) 'Bond Proceeds' 59,975 (detail index of the line with original_label 'Bond proceeds', section other financing). The schedule side 61,052 also counts the General Fund 'Insurance proceeds' 1,077 (p5, section other financing), which the statement side keeps in other_financing (Grants 500 + Insurance proceeds 1,077), not in debt_proceeds. 61,052 - 1,077 = 59,975. The insurance proceeds are not debt; no detail change.
